blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified Ethereum StakedUSDe source grants BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE the addToBlacklist/removeFromBlacklist functions. FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE blocks transfers, staking and unstaking; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can burn and redistribute an existing restricted holder's shares. At Ethereum block 26095796, owner() returned 0xe8dc0fab349ea169283c48ccfd09d797e6db7c94. The blacklist verdict remains Yes.

oracleRisk.summary: sUSDe is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over USDe and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation engine. It inherits the parent USDe offchain oracle and hedging-system risk.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: sUSDe's vault exchange rate values each share against the USDe held by the staking contract for minting and redemption, so the pro-rata share quote is a price-sensitive top-level authority. sUSDe creates no borrower-owned debt positions or collateral-liquidation markets, and therefore needs no branch rows.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: LayerZero metadata identifies Ethereum's sUSDe OFT adapter and 22 non-native OFT or OFT Adapter deployments. Pinned reads additionally confirm sUSDe deployments and LayerZero endpoints on Plasma and X Layer; their owners have changed since the July Safe observations. TON's tsUSDe jetton remains mintable with a disclosed admin. Route identities are documented, while complete messaging controls, TON bridge internals and current runtime materiality remain unresolved.
